name: Plant Annwn

attributes.attribute: lived beneath the lakes and vanished if a human broke their rules

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Plant Annwn, also written Plant Annwyn and Plant Rhys Dwr, are Welsh fairy people. Their names mean the tribe of the Otherworld and the tribe of Rhys the Deep. The fairy tribe made its home beneath the surface of lakes. They kept red-eared cattle, the Gwartheg y Llyn, and teams of white dogs, the Cwn Annwn. Like other fairy beings they could wed humans. If a human broke their rules, they vanished at once. The Plant Rhys Dwr were a different kind of fairy who traded well and became rich.

okr.objective: Describe the Plant Annwn as the lake-dwelling fairy tribe of Welsh lore.
key_results: Translate the name as tribe of the Otherworld.
State they lived below the surface of lakes.
